subject: Biennial Inaugural Ceremony
overview: The City of Medford held its biennial inaugural ceremony to swear in the Mayor, City Council, and School Committee members for the 2018–2019 term. Guest speakers and city officials delivered addresses reflecting on municipal progress and outline priorities for the upcoming term.

items.title: Welcome and Presentation of Colors
items.summary: Master of Ceremonies Roy Belson opened the inaugural proceedings and introduced the police honor guard to present the colors.

items.title: Invocation
items.summary: Deacon Mark Rumley delivered the invocation for the ceremony.

items.title: Address by Governor Charles D. Baker
items.summary: Governor Charles D. Baker spoke on the importance of state and local government collaboration and state investment in Medford's community programs.

items.title: Swearing-In of the Medford School Committee
items.summary: City Clerk Edward Finn administered the oath of office to the elected members of the Medford School Committee.

items.title: Musical Interlude
items.summary: The Medford High School Band Ensemble performed a musical selection.

items.title: Swearing-In of the Medford City Council
items.summary: City Clerk Edward Finn administered the oath of office to the incoming members of the Medford City Council.

items.title: City Council President Remarks
items.summary: City Council President Richard Caraviello delivered remarks emphasizing community pride, revitalization efforts, and collaborative leadership.

items.title: Musical Performance
items.summary: The Medford Public Schools String Ensemble performed for the audience.

items.title: Address by U.S. Senator Edward J. Markey
items.summary: U.S. Senator Edward J. Markey offered remarks praising the city's progress on public safety, vocational education, and economic growth.

items.title: Swearing-In of Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke
items.summary: Senator Edward J. Markey administered the mayoral oath of office to Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke.

items.title: Mayor's Inaugural Address
items.summary: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke delivered her inaugural address detailing plans for the Medford Square master plan, capital investments, transportation improvements, and community inclusivity.

items.title: Benediction and Closing Remarks
items.summary: Pastor Gerald Bell offered the benediction, and Master of Ceremonies Roy Belson offered closing remarks before concluding the ceremony.
